name: Paper Snow
source:
"Frosted in dust thick as white snow. My absence begins to yawn, our love grows a little too frail."

Paper Snow is a yuri kinetic novel about the pain and joy of knowing someone you love is happy without you. 

At some point in life, your path might diverge from the people you least expect to say goodbye to. There is no set when and where for this momentous event. No red circled reminder on a calendar, no ear-marked page on a journal. There is no indicator for the last time you’ll ever meet someone. Only the memory of it, after it’s all over.

[From [url=https://dacuriblue.itch.io/papersnow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「覆上一層厚如白雪的塵霜。我的缺席拉開了深淵，我們的愛也變得過於脆弱。」

《Paper Snow》是一部百合純閱讀視覺小說，描繪了得知所愛之人在沒有自己的生活裡依然幸福時，心中交織的痛楚與喜悅。

在人生的某個時刻，你或許會與最未曾料到要道別的人分道揚鑣。這樁意義重大的事並沒有既定的時間與地點——日曆上沒有畫著紅圈的提醒，日記裡也沒有折起書角的頁面。你與某人此生最後一次相見時，不會有任何預兆；唯有在一切落幕之後，只餘下那段回憶。

[引自[url=https://dacuriblue.itch.io/papersnow]Itch.io[/url]]
